verdict.rationale: Anytype's own docs describe reusable Templates: a saved page layout defined once that becomes the starting point for every new Note, Task or Project. Applying them to recurring kinds of notes is covered, but nothing in the evidence mentions variables such as date or title being filled in automatically, so only part of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: template variables/placeholders (date, title), independent or hands-on corroboration of the template workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can define reusable templates (with variables like date and title) and apply them when creating recurring kinds of notes

citations.quote: A Template is a saved layout for a page that you can reuse.
you define what a good starting point looks like once and it'll form the base for every new Object you create afterwards
Instead of starting every new Note, Task, or Project from a blank page, you define what a good starting point looks like once
